verification.authorize_after_org_scoped_find: Confirmed. Both #show and #create call authorize INSIDE exists(current_organization.jobs.where(id: params[:job_id]), ...). application_controller.rb:52-60 shows exists yields (yield obj.first) ONLY when obj.exists?; a cross-org job_id yields an empty org-scoped relation -> renders 'no job found' (422) and never yields, so authorize/render never run and no cross-org criteria can leak. authorize runs strictly after the org-scoped find in both actions.
verification.no_bypass_path: JobPolicy#update? = on_hiring_team? = is_org_admin? || record.users.include?(user); JobPolicy#show? = (is_org_user? && user.current_organization_user.jobs.where(id: record.id).any?) || is_org_admin?. Job#users (has_many :users through :organization_users through :hiring_team_memberships) is the hiring-team set. An outsider org member (is_org_user? true) is still denied both update? and show? because they are neither admin nor in the hiring-team set. No path lets an outsider through.
